headline: Learned models fuse heterogeneous cancer readouts to predict clinical and biological…
label: Ml Models For Cancer Prediction
summary: Multimodal fusion of CT imaging with transcriptome-derived metabolic models improves ovarian cancer survival estimation in a 2026 study.
synthesis: The dominant thread across these items is learned models that combine heterogeneous biological or clinical readouts to predict an endpoint. The ovarian cancer study fuses patient-specific metabolic models derived from transcriptomics with 3D CT imaging to improve survival estimation. Other items operate on a single data type: a stack-ensemble classifier on plasma cfDNA fragmentomics detects and subtypes gastric cancer (AUC 0.951 external validation), and RNABag is a transcriptome foundation model for pan-cancer classification across biopsy modalities. GlncDDR applies graph neural network embeddings to cancer gene expression to predict DDR-associated lncRNAs, and mDADGAN integrates lncRNAs into a heterogeneous network for miRNA-drug response prediction. What is new is coupling of modalities within a single model, though most items here remain single-modality, so this coupling is not yet the common pattern.
